title: Connection lookaside, reallocation, and OOM state for VDBE growth

scope.rationale: These connection-aware malloc.c routines form the direct allocation and failure closure reached by growOpArray: size measurement, two-size lookaside allocation/free, lookaside-to-heap and heap reallocation, sticky OOM, Parse propagation, and OOM clear.
excluded_responsibilities: String duplication and zeroing convenience wrappers
Global memory alarm, hard/soft limit, status, and allocator configuration ownership

dependencies.caller_closure: All connection-aware source functions directly reached by VDBE operation growth are assigned. Admission is blocked until global allocator/status and the additional owner-state representations are atomic units at source-translated or later.

inputs: Connection-owned optional lookaside storage and sticky OOM state
Requested byte count and optional prior allocation
Global process allocator result and usable size
outputs: Lookaside or heap allocation with source size semantics
Preserved old allocation on realloc failure
contracts.ownership: Lookaside slots return to the correct big/small free list. Heap blocks return to the process allocator. Realloc preserves old ownership on failure; successful lookaside growth copies the full old slot and returns it.
contracts.state_and_results: Allocation statistics, pnBytesFreed measurement mode, mallocFailed stickiness, nVdbeExec interrupt, Parse/outer-Parse error state, and OOM clear follow active malloc.c order.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Requires the connection mutex as a caller invariant. No I/O or application callback occurs.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: One-shot and sticky heap failures set OOM exactly once, preserve existing VDBE operations, reject later connection allocations, and resume only after OOM/fault clear.

representation_differences: Zig pointer range checks use integer addresses instead of SQLITE_WITHIN while preserving the same half-open lookaside interval.
The fixed out-of-memory sqlite3ErrorMsg call is folded to its exact post-mallocFailed Parse state because formatting cannot allocate after the sticky fault.
The process allocator is a typed Manager dependency rather than global C method-table calls; admission waits for that source unit.
C AtomicStore uses relaxed ordering; Zig uses @atomicStore with monotonic ordering, the corresponding Zig spelling for relaxed atomics.

oracle.protocol: The shared VDBE builder symbolic program drives lookaside allocation, allocator-reported size, successful growth, limit OOM, reached one-shot/sticky heap failures, sticky persistence, Parse propagation, and continuation through both C and Zig. Native allocator tests separately exercise big/small return lists and pnBytesFreed measurement.
internal_observations: Parse nErr/rc and connection error offset
big/small free-list ownership and measured size
oracle.normalization: Pointer values are not compared; allocation class, exact size/capacity, state, event order, and operation bytes are exact.

assurance.oom: 366-observation C/Zig trace reaches limit, one-shot, and sticky allocation failures and continuation; promotion waits for dependency admission.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; mutex-held behavior needs its dependency dossier.
assurance.malformed_input: Internal trusted sizes; global maximum-allocation enforcement belongs to the process allocator dependency.
assurance.continuation: Existing operation ownership and post-clear append are differentially observed.
assurance.performance: Two-size lookaside fast paths and geometric growth allocation counts are preserved; no standalone benchmark credit.

integration.native_call_path: Source-corresponding vdbe_aux operation growth calls this candidate directly; handwritten production Program construction remains separate.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Existing public/global allocation and handwritten compiler ownership remain until dependency and compiler integration.

independent_review.notes: Connection allocation and OOM traces pass; final compiler ownership, assurance, and independent review remain.

known_blockers: The global allocation core is source-translated; its alarm-event trace remains open but the connection allocation paths have their own exact builder differential.
Connection-owner integration, debug held assertions, complete caller closure, assurance, and independent review remain open.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/malloc.c:325-500 was reviewed through lookaside range/size, heap versus two-size lookaside size, bytes-freed measurement, correct free-list return, and nullable free
upstream/sqlite/src/malloc.c:575-744 was reviewed through heap fallback, sticky allocation, small/large init/free selection, reallocation in place or migration, copy, free, and failure ownership
upstream/sqlite/src/malloc.c:810-864 was reviewed completely for first non-benign OOM fault, running-VDBE interruption, lookaside disable, Parse-chain propagation, and guarded clear
upstream/sqlite/src/sqliteInt.h:220-245 and 1590-1628 were reviewed for relaxed AtomicStore and active two-size lookaside macros/constants; db_allocator/vdbe_types targets are AST-hashed
callers: VDBE growOpArray reaches sqlite3DbRealloc and therefore this complete connection allocation/OOM closure
Parser/compiler and connection-owned allocations use sqlite3DbMallocRawNN/free while holding db->mutex; db-null/public and convenience wrappers are excluded
Global heap fallback delegates to the reviewed process allocator; connection state representations cover every touched field
callees: Lookaside allocation prefers small free then small init, large free then large init, updating hit/size/full counters before heap fallback
Heap fallback calls sqlite3Malloc and sets OOM on null; free returns slots to the matching list, measures instead of freeing when pnBytesFreed is set, or delegates heap free
Realloc retains an adequate lookaside slot, migrates by allocating/copying full old slot/freeing old, or delegates heap realloc while preserving old owner on failure
OOM fault is sticky, ignored for benign allocation, interrupts active VDBEs with relaxed store, disables lookaside, and updates current/outer Parse; clear requires no executing VDBE
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 80 behavior IDs cover ranges/sizes, list ownership, measurement mode, sticky allocation, realloc classes/failure, and OOM/clear state
Connection mutex and pnBytesFreed invariants are explicit; no application callback or I/O occurs
Failed reallocation never frees the old owner; successful lookaside migration copies exactly the source slot capacity before returning it
LOOKASIDE_SMALL is 128 and two-size lookaside is active; omitted-lookaside branches are inactive
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/lookaside.test/lookaside2.test exercise small/large pools, counters, disable/enable, realloc, and returns
upstream/sqlite/test/malloc.test family and oomfault.test exercise one-shot/sticky failures, Parse propagation, interrupt, and continuation
Project VDBE builder/memory differentials reach limit, one-shot, sticky and clear paths while native allocator tests cover free lists and measurement; receipts remain later
